system_prompt_style.note: The bundle contains no AutoGPT platform source code. The repository evidence is AutoOPT (Shuvomoy/AutoOPT), which is a different system. Only the README and docs of Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT@f49bcca are available, so the place where the prompt is built is missing.

env_context_strategy.note: No AutoGPT prompt templates or tool list are in the bundle.

context_compaction.note: No AutoGPT run loop or context-management code is in the bundle.

observation_format.note: No AutoGPT code that converts observations is in the bundle.

tool_call_format.note: No AutoGPT output parser is in the bundle.

tool_count.note: The docs block list is truncated and there is no tool schema array. Blocks are workflow nodes, not tools the model is shown by default.

edit_primitive.note: No AutoGPT tool definitions are in the bundle.

tool_schema_source.note: No code that produces the tool schema is in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: Source and dependencies are not in the bundle, so a grep for mcp/a2a was not possible.

loop_primitives.note: The README describes visual block workflows run 'on demand, on a schedule, or from a trigger'. No run loop is in the bundle.

planning_granularity.note: No planning code is in the bundle.

multi_agent_topology.note: No agent factory code is in the bundle.

delegation_mechanism.note: No delegation code is in the bundle.

human_in_loop.note: The README mentions an 'action that needs your attention' in the dashboard. No mechanism for this is in the bundle.

short_term_state.note: No state object is in the bundle.

long_term_memory.note: The docs list an 'Add Memory' Mem0 block. This is a workflow block, not harness memory; no code is in the bundle.

state_persistence.note: No persistence code is in the bundle.

self_verification.note: No verification code is in the bundle.

retry_policy.note: No retry code is in the bundle.

rollback.note: No rollback code is in the bundle.

termination_condition.note: No run loop is in the bundle.

cost_controls.note: The README mentions the dashboard shows costs. No budget config is in the bundle.

timeouts.note: No timeout config is in the bundle.

execution_isolation.note: The README says self-hosting needs 'Docker and configuration required'. This concerns deployment of the platform, not isolation of agent actions.

filesystem_access.note: No workspace code is in the bundle.

network_policy.note: No network configuration is in the bundle.

permission_model.note: No permission code is in the bundle.

tracing.note: No logging or tracing code is in the bundle.

replayability.note: No replay code is in the bundle.

eval_hooks.note: The README links agbenchmark on PyPI for Classic only. The repository tree is not in the bundle, so it cannot be checked whether an evaluation runner ships in the pinned repo.

guardrails.note: No guardrail code is in the bundle.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AutoGPT provides access to hundreds of AI models and connects agents to 45+ platforms
target_domain.note: General workflow automation. 'other' is also arguable.

open_source.evidence_quote: Free for personal and internal business use; cannot be sold as a competing hosted service
open_source.note: autogpt_platform/ is under Polyform Shield, which is not an OSI licence. classic/ and the rest of the repo are MIT.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The platform comes pre-integrated with cutting-edge LLM providers:
model_agnostic.note: The docs list OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Llama and AI/ML API. No client abstraction code is in the bundle.

first_release_date.note: No tag history is in the bundle.

pinned_version.note: The bundle also contains unrelated AutoOPT repository evidence (Shuvomoy/AutoOPT v1.0.0) and an unrelated AutoPT paper (arXiv 2411.01236). Both were ignored as mismatched evidence.

stars.note: No gh api count is in the bundle. The README self-claims '185,000+ GitHub stars'.
